forecast_target: Round 2 forecast made after official Round 1 completion; no actual Round 2 data used.

method.simulation_engine: same frozen Stableford outcome probabilities and scoring/cut mechanics as existing Monte Carlo V1; V1 itself is read-only
method.r1_points: official KLPGA Stableford R1 points are fixed and counted once; only R2-R4 are simulated
method.r1_total_sg: official KLPGA R1 total SG and components are joined by player identity and included as observed audit covariates; no unvalidated SG-to-Stableford conversion or extra weight is applied
method.cut_rule: Top 60 and all ties after cumulative R1+R2 Stableford points; fixed R1 points + simulated R2 points determine cut
method.unknown_r1_data: none; every 108 official R1 Stableford row joins exactly to frozen V1 player identity and official SG identity

source_provenance.r1_result_page: https://klpga.co.kr/web/tourRecord/stablefordScoreRecord?gameCode=2026100004 (official-source transcription already held in candidate R1 page)
